title: Florida mom spots mysterious creature swimming through flooded street
excerpt: A Florida mom recorded a mysterious shark-like animal swimming through a flooded Fort Pierce street while heading to pick up her daughter from school. The viral video has sparked debate over whether t...
content:
Chris Pugh

Tue, November 10, 2026 at 5:07 PM UTC

1 min read

A Florida mom was heading to pick up her daughter from school when she spotted something she never expected to see swimming across a flooded street: what looked like a shark.

Franshara Napoleon was driving through Fort Pierce on Nov. 2 when she noticed an animal moving through deep water near 25th Street and Midway Road. She started recording and told Storyful that she thought the animal was a shark. "I was in disbelief," Napoleon said.

The video shows a dark animal moving through the flooded intersection with part of its body breaking the surface. FOX Weather described it as a possible small shark, but the animal has not been officially identified.

The strange sight came during extraordinary flooding along Florida's Treasure Coast. The severe weather was part of historic flooding that hit communities across Florida, while Treasure Coast Newspapers reported that Fort Pierce broke its Nov. 2 rainfall record. About 12 inches fell in parts of St. Lucie County, according to a National Weather Service meteorologist.

The flooding became serious enough that the City of Fort Pierce declared a local state of emergency. Officials warned people to avoid flooded roads because standing water could be deeper and more dangerous than it appeared.

And the mystery animal was not the only unusual swimmer. FOX Weather reported that large tarpon were also recorded swimming through a flooded park roughly an hour north in Indian Harbour Beach.
